item.title: Prof. Musa Al-Gharbi's "Jason Arday and Me"

Here are two brief excerpts, but they can't do justice to the whole piece, which covers much more ground: {[W]hen a mainstream journalist [investigated Arday], he was threatened with lawsuits , visited by the police , and subsequently instructed by his editors to bury the story—and he sheepishly complied.
